newsitem.title: USA: Hvide gets patent for docking module.
newsitem.headline: Hvide gets patent for docking module.

text.p: Hvide Marine Inc said on Thursday that it received U.S. Patent and Trademark Office patent approval for its new ship docking module.
Hvide said the double-ended, round-shaped module's Z-drives mounted fore and aft and offset from the center give it equal propulsion in all directions.
The company said the module is designed to operate with two crew members, thus reducing operating costs by comparison with conventional harbor tugs.
Hvide said it has three docking modules on order and expects delivery by the end of 1997.
Hvide has a fleet of 159 vessels providing marine support services for the offshore energy industry, and transporting chemicals and petroleum products.
Hvide shares were up 1/8 to 21-7/8 in midday trading.
